messages.content: "請問您能否提供我過去30天內微軟和蘋果的以下財務數據？首先，我想知道微軟股票的平均收盤價，使用的資料來源是Yahoo Finance。其次，我需要知道蘋果的總收入，使用的資料來源是Google Finance。第三，我對微軟和蘋果的股票交易總量也感興趣，同樣使用的資料來源是Yahoo Finance。請您幫我計算這些數據好嗎？"

For avg_closing_price: company="Microsoft", days=30, data_source="Yahoo Finance". For total_revenue: company="Apple", days=30, data_source="Google Finance". For volume_traded: company="Microsoft", days=30, data_source="Yahoo Finance" and also for Apple. We can call each separately or combine? The function signature expects one company at a time.
